answer: Local anthropic and openai adapters both ran canary WU-A6-CANARY. Both artifacts validate against the identical schema file command-center/schema/work-result.schema.json (sha256=c4a4ee50425ca0866b0b7f14228e646a0a50b508abb958ecbd453e6ebee3a918) and both satisfy the shared completion predicate (schema-valid + state/verdict SUCCESS + sentinel SUCCESS:WU-A6-CANARY + empty mismatches). Disabling schema_support on openai turns the differential from CONFORMANT to MISMATCH (not PASS). Live vendor-API cells were not executed and stay NOT-CHECKED; they are not copied from the local PASS cells. The suite does not claim semantic interchangeability: a ranking/choice payload swap still CONFORMANT. SUCCESS:ARC-0043
